objective: Build first playable Living Kingdom Godot DEV vertical slice with 13 realm identities and 39 canonical game-linked local adventure specifications, without retiring original games or reopening Arena/estate. Add 13 distinct procedural realm art directions, bounded props, guide dialogue, dynamic lighting and realm-specific mission layouts. Replace existing sprite guides and shared explorer rig with 13 original generated articulated GLBs, new animation tracks and original synthesized audio. Replace imported Kingdom environment props with original procedural geometry and surface shader, and wire interactive animation and sound. Upgrade character mesh topology to actual glTF skinned skeletons, material-batched surfaces, blended joint weights, facial and hand detail, denser authored motion. Add 13 original realm audio soundscapes and acceleration/deceleration matched to native animation. Embed original procedural PBR texture maps, fit bind-pose ground alignment, sculpt irregular terrain, instanced foliage, masonry windows and flowing water effects. Add tangent-correct original PBR meshes, 44.1 kHz audio, continuous loop crossfades and fail-closed binary validation.
productionBaselineEvidence: Kingdom restoration source c9bc8a6c is DEV only; last verified staging runtime 2.0.6 group cc65a12a-3e1b-45fa-aa6a-1e2ed27f0f31. No production change authorized.
chosenApproach: Generate original indexed 3D character meshes and five articulated animation clips per design, integrate direct GLB loading and seven original layered PCM cues, retain old games as fallback; gate native release.
selectionRationale: Highest practical gain from existing Godot bridge while device startup remains unverified. Preserve original 39 games and Character authority.
alternativeApproaches: Replace existing games wholesale: rejected before gameplay parity.
New native APK or backend reward settlement: deferred until compatibility and security verification.
preserveBehaviors: Original Kingdom routes, ads, character progression and collection remain; offline adventures never modify BP or reward ledgers.
Arena, Entry Map and estate routes remain retired in Genesis MAIN. Native package unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Run Node catalogue/source tests and Godot 4.7.2 headless scene smoke against exact generated pack.
Android startup, rendering, touch, audio and ads verified before enabling DEV launcher in release.
Verify each realm has imported props, original character guide texture, unique biome and correct movement bounds; no fake entitlement.
Validate all 13 GLB headers, mesh counts, named animations, and seven WAV files; inspect actual Godot visual/audio on device before release.
Original environment geometry, no imported props in Living Kingdom, actual on-device appearance, motion and audio evaluation.
Inspect decoded GLB inverse bind matrices, normalized vertex weights, joint/index range and actual Godot Skeleton3D import.
Validate 13 stereo ambience headers, peak bounds and clean loop endpoints; verify walking/running transitions, reaction holds and audio focus on Android.
Inspect GLB embedded PNG maps and render actual Godot water, terrain, skinned character faces and animation before release.
Strict media gate verifies topology, skin weights, normals/tangents, animation loops, PNG CRC, PCM peak and loop boundaries before pack generation.
